item.title: Delilah Dallas makes a star‑studded debut
item.description: Delilah Dallas, a '20s-inspired supper club, officially opened its doors with a star-studded grand opening party featuring live music, burlesque performers, and a special appearance by Machine Gun Kelly.

item.title: State Fair of Texas awards $650K in grants to local nonprofits
item.description: The State Fair of Texas awarded over $654,000 in program funding to 145 organizations serving the South Dallas and Fair Park area in 2025, and is now accepting applications for its 2026 Community Giving Program.

item.title: Thrift for Good Launches Valentine’s Week Sale With Up to 75% Off
item.description: Thrift for Good will host a week-long Valentine's Day event at its Denton and Hurst locations from Feb. 9-14, featuring family activities, discounts on holiday merchandise, and donations to local charities.

item.title: Free mosaic event at Epiphany Gallery unites community
item.description: Artist Reginald Adams will lead a free community art project at Epiphany Gallery on Feb. 14 and 15, inviting participants of all ages to help create a shared mosaic celebrating life in The Flats.

item.title: Most searched medical questions revealed in new study
item.description: A new study from Soliant Health has identified the most searched medical questions in every state for 2026, revealing a range of health concerns from sleep issues to contagious illnesses.

item.title: Free construction summer camp for middle schoolers returns
item.description: The Rosendin Foundation is hosting TRF Camp Build, a free one-day construction summer camp for middle school students, on May 16, providing hands-on experience in the construction trades and introducing students to career opportunities in the skilled trade industry.

item.title: Texas sports fans unite across political divides, study finds
item.description: A recent study found that 92% of Texas sports fans believe major athletic events serve as a bridge for political divides, while 72% of respondents reported feeling a stronger sense of national or regional unity during these events.

item.title: Moviegoers are fed up: The growing debate over theater etiquette
item.description: Moviegoers are expressing frustration online about disruptive behavior in theaters, sparking a debate about whether theaters should enforce stricter rules or evolve with modern audience behavior.

item.title: Texas tops list for truck stops; Dallas named best city
item.description: Love's Travel Stops has been named the top truck stop in the US, with Texas leading the rankings as the best state for truck stops and Dallas as the top city.

item.title: Amazon compiled its bestselling Valentine’s gifts so far
item.description: Amazon’s "Top 100" Valentine’s list takes the pressure off choosing the perfect gift.
